name: shadcn-solid
summary: Community SolidJS port of shadcn/ui: copy-paste components built on Kobalte UI, with docs and a CLI.
description: An unofficial community-led SolidJS port of shadcn/ui: accessible, customizable components you copy into your app, built on Kobalte UI primitives. Docs cover each component with installation and usage, plus example apps (mail, cards, authentication); a CLI and a changelog track component updates such as navigation menu, menubar, number field, OTP field and sonner.
contains: copy-paste SolidJS components built on Kobalte UI
component docs for accordion, alert, calendar, checkbox, command, date picker, drawer, menubar, navigation menu
CLI to add components to a project
changelog tracks added components (navigation menu, menubar, number field, OTP field and more)
